LESSON: LIGHT

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: FORCE AND ENERGY
Topic 3.1: Light

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Light
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does light travel?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. demonstrate the movement of light through materials
2. draw ray diagrams of images formed in plane mirrors
3. describe the formation of rainbow in nature
4. appreciate the importance of movement light in everyday life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Light

Teach
• Observe Light in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Light (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Light.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Light.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Light.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• demonstrate the movement of light through materials
• draw ray diagrams of images formed in plane mirrors
• describe the formation of rainbow in nature

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Light.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Light: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does light travel?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• demonstrate the movement of light through materials
• draw ray diagrams of images formed in plane mirrors
• describe the formation of rainbow in nature
• appreciate the importance of movement light in everyday life

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
